Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the agent relied on incomplete and potentially inaccurate data extracted from search result snippets rather than successfully retrieving the full lists from the authoritative source (Box Office Mojo). After the initial web scraping attempt failed (Step 2), the agent abandoned the automated retrieval of the complete top 10 lists and instead manually listed only 7 worldwide and 5 domestic movies based on limited search snippets. This resulted in an incomplete dataset that could not accurately represent the "top 10" lists required by the task, leading to a potentially incorrect final count of common movies.
